Estimation settings

pk_est.Rd

Creates the settings object used by pk_run(). Unspecified arguments are taken from the estimation section of the project config.

Usage

pk_est(
  method = NULL,
  seed = NULL,
  nBurn = NULL,
  nEm = NULL,
  maxOuterIterations = NULL,
  covMethod = NULL,
  ...,
  proj = NULL
)

Arguments

method

"saem_focei" (default), "focei" or "saem".

seed

Seed for SAEM.

nBurn, nEm

Number of SAEM burn-in and EM iterations.

maxOuterIterations

Maximum outer iterations of FOCEI.

covMethod

Covariance step method for FOCEI (e.g. "r,s").

...

Further settings stored with the run (not used by the default fit function).

proj

A pk_project; only used to read defaults.

Value

A pk_est object (a list).

Details

The default method "saem_focei" estimates the model with SAEM and then refines it with FOCEI started from the SAEM solution. With oral data only and slow absorption (ka smaller than the elimination rate constant) the individual likelihood surfaces can be multimodal. FOCEI alone can then converge to different sets of individual modes depending on the starting values, and the reported OFV of the same population model can differ by several tens of points. SAEM locates the population optimum and consistent individual modes robustly, and FOCEI started from it provides the FOCEI OFV used for likelihood-ratio tests and the covariance step. The OFV reproducibility across SAEM seeds can be checked with pk_repro().

Examples

pk_est(method = "focei")
#> <pk_est> "focei", seed 2026
